title: Show HN: Garden of Flowers – an archive of pictorial typography before ASCII art
summary: An extensive digital archive documenting the history of pictorial typography and letterpress art from the 1600s to modern times, created by a researcher who traced the overlooked precursors to ASCII art through eight years of dedicated study and collection building.
problem_solved: Documents the missing historical link between 17th-century letterpress art and modern ASCII art, addressing the lack of scholarly attention to typography-based visual imagery.
why_valuable: Preserves and illuminates an overlooked artistic tradition that predates digital text art by centuries, providing valuable historical context for understanding the evolution of visual communication.
